findings.description: Directly inspected the regenerated front, back, side and three-quarter renders plus all six poses. The jacket remains nearly featureless white: the broad plastron and rear waist adjustment are absent; elbow diamonds and diagonal marking are faint contour lines rather than clear constructed details.
Both sleeves and underarms retain dense irregular faceting and wrinkles in neutral, arms-up, arm-cross and prone poses. The sleeve surface remains visibly rough.

Direct inspection of the current front/back/side/three-quarter views and all six poses confirms the skirt remains uncontrolled and opens into separated flaps under crouch; sitting lifts the skirt and exposes large gaps around blunt cylindrical shorts. Same-pose surface projection measured under-shorts coverage on posterior pelvis samples at 17.7% crouch and 19.3% sit, and upper-thigh samples at 60.6% crouch and 60.1% sit. Overskirt posterior-pelvis coverage was 59.0% crouch and 60.7% sit, with 80.6 mm and 115.5 mm p95 ray gaps. This is a geometric diagnostic only, not fit acceptance.
The collar is still a narrow upright open tube; the diagonal piping does not create a visible fencing plastron or secure-looking closure. Neck clearance is not established.
These are Blender prototype renders only. Shape Key fit, continuous penetration, accepted deformation weights, Unity prefab integration, VRChat Build & Test and SDK upload remain unverified.
Upper front torso overlap remains visible and front edges remain unfastened. Sewn waistband now covers the former neutral waist transition gap, but jacket retention and waist fit are not accepted.

Outer shoulder edge now uses an evaluated body surface support sample rather than the UpperArm bone height. Tall collar persists. Head clearance, collar strain and continuous surface intersection remain unapproved; historical seam lengths are bound to their original source hashes.

Current eleven images inspected: sleeve folds remain visible, especially underarm/rear and arms-up. Earlier cuff/clearance measurements and their improvements are historical, bound to prior source hashes; they are not current-source measured fit evidence. Continuous clearance, strain, Large and runtime remain unverified.

All five current views and six poses directly inspected after 140 mm skirt length, reference-ratio flare, matching flat pattern intake and current-input native bending solve. Standing flare is improved over the previous narrow skirt. Irregular folds, front sag/dent and insufficient visible under-shorts remain; broad ordered reference pleats are not achieved. No final appearance acceptance.

Current crouch and sit directly inspected: front skirt forms raised broad flaps, side/rear hem curls and shorts coverage remains unaccepted. Prone also inspected. Skirt transfer to thigh bones is a hypothesis to investigate using actual current vertex weights; no continuous penetration, dynamic cloth, strain or runtime acceptance is claimed.

Current arms-up and arm-cross directly inspected: underarm/sleeve folds persist; collar remains tall. Waist appears assembled in the rendered pose but measured fit, strain and continuous clearance remain unverified.
